_meta.title: AccessMI public data index
_meta.description: Machine-readable list of the static files AccessMI publishes for reuse, with the meaning each value needs to keep. This is a project-specific index, not an implementation of an external catalog standard.

access.rate_limit: Limit requests to one per second and send an identifying User-Agent (llms.txt). Not enforced by the server.
access.query_api: none. Every dataset is a whole-file download; there is no filtering, pagination or change notification.
access.caching: /data/* responses carry Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600, stale-while-revalidate=86400 (netlify.toml).
access.errors: An unknown path returns HTTP 404 with an HTML body. Treat any non-200 response, or any non-JSON body for a .json path, as unavailable.
access.change_detection: Compare _meta.generated (source catalog) or provenance.ingested_at (datasets) between reads. /.well-known/build.json records the live commit.
access.robots_txt_scope: robots.txt allows crawling of this site. It is not a license and says nothing about upstream publishers' terms or about model training.
access.upstream_terms: AccessMI has not recorded reuse terms for any upstream feed (source catalog pendingItems: license-review). A null license means unknown, not open.
access.code_license: MIT (repository code only). Upstream data keeps its publishers' terms.

datasets.title: Michigan county income and poverty (Census SAIPE)
datasets.source_program: Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates (SAIPE)
datasets.reporting_period: Calendar-year estimate named by provenance.estimate_year. The retrieval date is not the reporting period.
datasets.uncertainty: counties[].confidence holds 90% lower and upper bounds published by the Census Bureau. schoolAgePovertyPct has no bounds in this file; treat its uncertainty as unavailable. Overlapping intervals do not establish a difference.
datasets.missingness: A suppressed or unpublished cell is null, never zero. counties[].status and pendingReason explain unavailable rows.
comparability: SAIPE is model-based and differs from ACS poverty estimates; do not mix SAIPE and ACS values in one comparison.
County estimates do not apply to ZIP Code Tabulation Areas or tracts.
datasets.attribution: Cite the U.S. Census Bureau SAIPE program and the estimate year. Upstream reuse terms are not recorded by AccessMI.

datasets.title: AccessMI source catalog
datasets.publisher: AccessMI (catalog); each entry names its own publisher
datasets.epistemic_label_note: The catalog describes feeds; it holds no measurements. Per-feed vintage, geography and license are null where unknown.
datasets.missingness: null license, vintage, geographyLevel or lastVerified means unknown. attributionUnverified: true means the publisher name is still being confirmed.

datasets.title: Census county name and code lookup (national)
datasets.epistemic_label_note: Names and FIPS codes only. Contains no income, poverty or margin-of-error values.
datasets.missingness: Row 0 of data is the header row.
datasets.upstream_terms_note: _meta.license reads "US Public Domain" as recorded by the ingest job; AccessMI has not independently reviewed it (pendingItems: license-review).

datasets.title: Open-data ingestion manifest
datasets.epistemic_label_note: Lists files produced by the ingestion job; holds no measurements.

datasets.title: Live build and release provenance
datasets.description: Commit, source tree, lockfile hash, critical dataset hashes and ingest dates of the deployed build. Written at build time by scripts/write-build-manifest.mjs.

datasets.title: SAM.gov exclusions snapshot
datasets.reason: Not populated (count 0; the ingest needs a SAM_API_KEY that is not configured). An empty list does NOT mean no exclusions exist.

datasets.title: U.S. county boundaries (TopoJSON, map rendering asset)
datasets.reason: Map rendering asset for the site; provenance and vintage are not documented here.
